notes.text: Sizing plan: fit to the prop_tiny conformance (capsule r 0.25 m, h 0.7 m) at a target height of 0.6 m. Real garden gnomes are 0.3-0.5 m, but style.md section 3 sets 0.6 m as the minimum mesh height that reads at battle distance, so 0.6 m is the smallest size that stays readable while still clearly a small garden ornament next to the 1.8 m hero (about a third of hero height). Next step after approval: Meshy image-to-3D (about 30 credits).

provenance.prompt: A classic garden gnome statue: chunky body, tall pointed red hat, big white beard, round nose, blue coat, brown belt, standing on its own feet with arms at its sides. Style: stylized storybook fantasy, cel-shaded, hand-painted look, chunky readable shapes, bold silhouette, simplified masses, clear joint and part separation, saturated but not neon colours. Texture: flat even matte albedo, clean colour regions, no baked lighting or shadows, no dirt, no fine noise. Staging: single subject centred, whole subject in frame with a generous margin, plain light grey background, no floor, no cast shadow, even flat lighting, orthographic camera, front three-quarter view, no text, no labels. Nothing else in the scene: no base, no plinth, no plants, no people.
